title: It’s so pretty T^T
body: This app is so pretty and I use it to track my habits like not biting my nails or making the bed as soon as I get out of it in the morning.  It’s been so helpful and I’m so happy that it matches the aesthetic of the other apps by the developer so that my phone just feels like it had the prettiest makeover ever.  I realllyyyyyyy recommend it!!
author: abyssari

title: Love love loveee this app
body: It’s such a great habit tracker, so easy to use and is so cute! Has the most adorable icons for habits and the widget is both beautifully designed and useful to see all habits I need to tick off. I’ve tried many habit trackers and honestly this one beats them all 🫶
author: k.m242

title: One of the most amazing apps!!!!
body: I figured this app through searching for apps that I could use to help - especially to start with my goals and bettering myself - I am so happy I discovered this!!!! it’s so useful to use! I’ve now got the premium version and I’m so excited for the new year and to reach my goals🩷
author: rookienoodelsjana

title: not usable for free
body: worth noting that you’re only allowed 3 habits maximum and your options are practically drink water, meditate, and sleep. if you want otherwise you must pay £10. in other words it’s unusable unless you pay a ridiculous amount.

title: You have to pay to get the best results
body: I downloaded it as it looked cute and it is, however, you can only add 1 habit for free, it’s not even like half free half not , you pick one and then you can’t have any others and it is really quite expensive to pay for more habits. really disappointed
author: Jessphonour

title: Pretty, but overpriced
body: It makes you pay a subscription if you want more than one habit which is crazy - a free version should not be THAT limited
author: monobami

title: Amazing app and developer
body:
I’ve used two other apps from this developer, and they’ve all been absolutely brilliant! They’re beautifully designed, easy to use, and just a pleasure overall. This habit tracker is no different—it’s stylish, intuitive, and exactly what I need to help me build healthier habits as i go into the new year.

What really stands out is the developer—they’re incredibly kind and genuinely care about their users, which is so rare these days. If you’re thinking about downloading this app, go for it! And definitely check out their other apps too—you won’t regret it.
author: Samxx84

title: Wonderful app
body: Absolutely beautiful helpful app and the makers of the app are wonderful to thank you so much
author: Donna446

title: Love this so much!!
body:
This app has helped me loads!! When i usually use a routine app, i give up after a few uses as it feels like a chore. But this app, first of all, has a gorgeous layout. Secondly, motivates me to go through with it as although the app is new, it tracks your progress and lets you know how far you’ve gone. I will use this a lot more often now that i’ve got my subscription!! 
Thank you so much,
Gianna x

title: 1 habit only
body: I can only add 1 habit for free then it makes you pay for a subscription. Useless app.
